description: This file contains a Drupal hook implementation class 'DemoUmamiHooks' for the 'demo_umami' profile, including methods for help text, form alterations, toolbar modifications, user password setting, and navigation content, specific to the demo_umami profile.

classes.name: DemoUmamiHooks
classes.description: A class implementing various Drupal hooks for the demo_umami profile, including help, form, toolbar, navigation, and user password management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: module handler, current user, admin context, and entity type manager.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help page content specific to the demo_umami profile.

methods.name: formInstallConfigureFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the site configuration form to set default site name and add submit handler.

methods.name: installConfigureSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to set user passwords.

methods.name: toolbar
methods.description: Adds a warning item to the admin toolbar about the demo profile.

methods.name: setUserPasswords
methods.description: Sets the password for all users with roles 'author' or 'editor' to the provided password.

methods.name: navigationContentTop
methods.description: Adds a warning message to the top navigation for demonstration purposes.
